_about: Reverse-engineering target binaries (ASTRO25 CPS/Depot) for open-astro-cps. Resolved by tools/re_paths.py so no agent hardcodes a machine path. The ROOT is machine-specific and is NOT stored here: set env OPENASTRO_RE_ROOT, OR drop a gitignored re_sources.local.json next to this file ({"root": "<abs path>"}). The 'binaries' paths are RELATIVE to that resolved root; 'fallback_roots' are tried (expanduser) only when no env/local override resolves.
